example: A shopper asks AI for running shoes. Real incumbents (Brooks, ASICS, Hoka) are in the answer; the fictional challenger brand Stridewell (stridewell.com) is not. hyperank gets Stridewell mentioned and cited; a shopper clicks and buys. Every simulated AI answer carries a small 'Illustrative' tag.
device: INTERACTIVE QUESTIONS: each act opens with a question to the viewer typed into the same glass chat composer (blinking cursor, letter by letter), then the voice answers it. The composer is the film's recurring object, along with the AI answer card it produces.

scenes.vo: Your next customer is asking AI what to buy. Like this.
scenes.tts: Your next customer is asking A-I what to buy. Like this.
scenes.visual: Bright stage with depth. Frame 1 already moving: the glass chat composer with the official ChatGPT mark types 'What are the best running shoes for flat feet?' letter by letter. Official engine marks (Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, Google AI Overviews, Meta AI) float on soft-focus planes behind. Never Grok. SFX: key ticks.

scenes.vo: In seconds, AI gives one answer. Three brands, and links to the sources it trusts. That's the whole shortlist.
scenes.tts: In seconds, A-I gives one answer. Three brands, and links to the sources it trusts. That's the whole shortlist.
scenes.visual: THE HERO ANSWER CARD streams in below the composer, large and legible: '1. Brooks Adrenaline GTS', '2. ASICS Gel-Kayano', '3. Hoka Arahi', each with a short reason line. Citation chips under it: runnersworld.com, reddit.com/r/RunningShoeGeeks, a review site. Small corner tag 'Illustrative'. On 'That's the whole shortlist' a soft violet bracket wraps the three names.

scenes.vo: Now picture Stridewell, a great running brand that isn't in that answer. Or picture your own brand. When your buyers ask, are you in the answer?
scenes.tts: Now picture Stridewell, a great running brand that isn't in that answer. Or picture your own brand. When your buyers ask, are you in the answer?
scenes.visual: A fourth row slides into the answer card, 'Stridewell', then greys out and drops away. The composer clears and types the viewer question: 'Is my brand in the answer?'. The cursor blinks and holds on the question mark.

scenes.vo: It's not just shoppers. In a G2 survey, half of B2B software buyers now start their research with an AI chatbot more often than with Google.
scenes.tts: It's not just shoppers. In a G-2 survey, half of B-2-B software buyers now start their research with an A-I chatbot more often than with Google.
scenes.visual: The answer card drifts back out of focus. '51%' rises large in violet with a soft depth shadow, count already in motion on frame 1, then holds. Source line bottom-left, small: 'Source: G2, The Answer Economy, April 2026. Survey of 1,076 B2B software buyers.'

scenes.vo: And 69 percent chose a different vendor than planned, because a chatbot recommended it.
scenes.tts: And sixty-nine percent chose a different vendor than planned, because a chatbot recommended it.
scenes.visual: The 51 rolls to 69 in place. Below it, a 'Planned vendor' chip slides out of a buyer's shortlist and a 'Recommended by AI' chip slides in. Same source line.

scenes.vo: If you're not in the answer, you never see the loss. No visit, no form fill, nothing in your CRM.
scenes.tts: If you're not in the answer, you never see the loss. No visit, no form fill, nothing in your C-R-M.
scenes.visual: Three glass tiles in depth, each flat-lining in turn: 'Website visits, no change', 'Form fills, no change', 'CRM, no record'.

scenes.vo: That's what hyperank fixes. We get your brand mentioned and cited in AI answers, so buyers find you first.
scenes.tts: That's what Hyper rank fixes. We get your brand mentioned and cited in A-I answers, so buyers find you first.
scenes.visual: SIGNATURE MOMENT, bright throughout. The stage clears to white, the hyperank mark draws itself with a soft violet glow, a light sweep crosses the frame, and the full silver laptop rises and settles with a slight rotateX and a specular sweep across the lid. Its screen shows the hyperank.ai hero (site crop hero.png, the visor figure). The 'ChatGPT recommends you', 'Claude recommends you' chips lift off the screen one at a time.

scenes.vo: First, we show you what AI says about you. We ask your buyers' real questions across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and more, and keep every answer, word for word.
scenes.tts: First, we show you what A-I says about you. We ask your buyers' real questions across Chat G-P-T, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and more, and keep every answer, word for word.
scenes.visual: Viewer question typed in the composer first: 'What does AI say about my brand?'. The composer docks above the laptop. Screen wipes to the site section 'Every answer, kept word for word' (card-answers.png, 2x); camera pushes in; ONE lift out of the screen: the Tracked prompts card, with Stridewell questions.

scenes.vo: You see who gets named instead of you, your share of voice, and anything AI gets wrong, like an old price or a discontinued product.
scenes.tts: You see who gets named instead of you, your share of voice, and anything A-I gets wrong, like an old price or a discontinued product.
scenes.visual: Screen wipes to the app Control Center for stridewell.com. Lift 1, large: Share of voice, Stridewell 9% beside Brooks, ASICS and Hoka. Lift 2: one AI claim 'Stridewell only makes trail shoes' struck through in place, verdict pill 'Outdated'. Never more than two lifts.

scenes.vo: Why does AI pick them, and not you? The sources it trusts. Reviews, Reddit threads, comparison pages. hyperank finds the exact sources deciding your answer.
scenes.tts: Why does A-I pick them, and not you? The sources it trusts. Reviews, Reddit threads, comparison pages. Hyper rank finds the exact sources deciding your answer.
scenes.visual: Viewer question typed first: 'Why does AI pick them?'. MATCH CUT: the hero answer card from s02 returns above the laptop; its citation chips drop and unfold into the site's 'Sources deciding the answer' graph (sources-deciding.png, 2x, rival labels as Brooks, ASICS, Hoka). The '+ Add' buttons light in sequence.

scenes.vo: Then we fix them. We create what those sources are missing: roundups, comparisons, persona pages, listicles, how-tos and articles, each engineered the way AI picks what to cite.
scenes.tts: Then we fix them. We create what those sources are missing: roundups, comparisons, persona pages, listicles, how-tos and articles, each engineered the way A-I picks what to cite.
scenes.visual: Six page cards fan out from the laptop screen in a shallow 3D arc, one per format word, each with a real Stridewell title ('Best running shoes for flat feet, tested', 'Stridewell vs Brooks: which fits wide feet', 'Running shoes for nurses on 12-hour shifts' ...). On 'engineered' the arc collapses into ONE large page with three passages highlighting in violet ink: 'Direct answer', 'Clear facts', 'Sourced stat'. Use the site's Content Engine graphic (card-content.png) for the publish list.

scenes.vo: It publishes to your site and the sites AI reads. And our agents join the Reddit and LinkedIn threads where your buyers are already asking.
scenes.tts: It publishes to your site and the sites A-I reads. And our agents join the Reddit and LinkedIn threads where your buyers are already asking.
scenes.visual: The page flies into the site's integrations cards (integrations4.png: WordPress, Webflow, Ghost, Shopify), each lighting as it lands. Then a Reddit thread card ('r/RunningShoeGeeks: wide toe box recs?') with a drafted reply naming Stridewell and citing a source, beside a LinkedIn post card. Official Reddit and LinkedIn marks.

scenes.vo: Weeks later, a shopper asks the same question. This time, AI names Stridewell, and links to it.
scenes.tts: Weeks later, a shopper asks the same question. This time, A-I names Stridewell, and links to it.
scenes.visual: PAYOFF of the hero card. The same composer types the same s01 question. The answer re-streams; this time 'Stridewell' is in the list with a violet citation chip 'stridewell.com'. Corner tag 'Illustrative'. Soft chime.
